summary: [standards] Code hygiene: (1) l1_plan.rs:320-325 is a loop over read commands whose body only `continue`s, under a comment that says validators run for read commands; dead code. (2) l1.rs:1 and :173 say 'the 30 L1 checks'; the table has 31. (3) `atip check --help` (cli.rs:64) lists the fixture keys without `prepare` and `paged`. (4) plan_nexts caps the followed `meta.next` entries at MAX_NEXT_RUNS = 300 with `.take`, and reports nothing when it drops entries, where L1.next says every observed entry. (5) ECMASCRIPT_UNICODE '17.0' and RUST_UNICODE '16.0.0' (regex.rs:12-14) are literals; only U+11DB0 ties them to the crates, so a regress or regex-syntax bump makes the notes of L1.patterns wrong silently. Blast radius: documentation and the wording of one note; no check result changes.
